## Song generation with ACE-Step 1.5 XL SFT (4B) - MIT

**The song flow.** ACE-Step 1.5 XL is the same family as the 8-step turbo that ships as S19, at **4B** and
**50 steps / cfg 7**, and it is the one that reliably *sings*: on a style that names a clear lead it put
**124 of 188 lyric words** into the mix where the turbo, on the same text, produced no vocal at all (E13b).

- **the style is the vocal's on/off switch.** `tags` (node 7) both describes the music and decides whether a
  voice appears at all, so name it and keep it consistent with the lyric: a "clear, strong, close-mic lead"
  request was obeyed, while a "shouted male lead" style came back **whispered** (E13).
- **`lyrics`** empty means instrumental; size it to the duration (~1.5-3 words per second, so 120 s wants
  250-350 words - E7).
- **the seed and the duration are each wired to two consumers** (the text encoder and the sampler / the
  latent), so the graph cannot disagree with itself - the same pattern as `ace-step.json`.
- **`ModelSamplingAuraFlow` shift 3** sits between the UNet and the sampler, as upstream's template ships it.

**Files (~19 GB, all MIT, `Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files`):**
`models/diffusion_models/acestep_v1.5_xl_sft_bf16.safetensors` ·
`models/text_encoders/qwen_0.6b_ace15.safetensors` + `qwen_4b_ace15.safetensors` ·
`models/vae/ace_1.5_vae.safetensors`.

**Cost:** ~50 s of sampling per 120 s song once the model is loaded (a cold first run is minutes); the ground
truth for a take is a spectrogram plus ASR - see `audio/README.md` traps. It lands at **0.0 dBFS**.

---
*How to run it: story **S23** in `HOWTO.md`  ·  Why it is this way: **E13/E13b** in `audio/EXPERIMENTS.md`.*

widgets_values: Anthemic pop-rock ballad with a clear, strong, close-mic male lead vocal, big live drums, driving guitars, warm bass, piano and strings, polished modern production, confident and uplifting

[Verse]
Steel is breathing in the dark
Pistons counting out the hour
Every window blind with sparks
Every hand a kind of power
Hammers fall like steady rain
On the anvil of the day
We are forging something nameless
From the rust and from the clay

[Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Verse]
Furnace glow along the floor
Shadows walk the factory wall
We have heard the engines roar
And we never once will fall
Oil and smoke and borrowed light
Every rivet set in time
We will work into the night
Till the morning bells will chime

[Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Bridge]
And when the metal sings
And when the silence breaks
We will know the shape of things
By everything it makes

[Final Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Outro]
Turn the wheel, turn the wheel
Hold the line
